body.title: git_tree: worktree and index operations
body.summary: Add git_tree with checkout-index, clean, restore, mv, sparse-checkout, submodule, rerere, merge-file, bisect and replay, with the destructive inputs (clean, restore of the worktree, checkout-index force, mv --force, submodule deinit and forced update, merge-file writing in place) as input-dependent classes. Mark the rows covered with cases and approval cases; only this Task's own rows are checked.
acceptanceChecks: Each op has a coverage case that checks the working tree or index effect
Every destructive input asks every time and is denied with no client before git starts, and the safe input is common
replay and other newer commands fail with git's message and the recorded version when git is older

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: git_tree covered rows change the working tree or index as the command does
